summary: Apply the OKR Framework to set ambitious, measurable goals that align teams around outcomes. Provide source URLs for authoritative, verified results.

tools.name: OKR Template
tools.description: Captures Objectives and Key Results in a structured format.
tools.artifactStructure:
## Objective
[Qualitative, ambitious goal]

## Key Results
1. [Measurable outcome 1] — Target: 
2. [Measurable outcome 2] — Target: 
3. [Measurable outcome 3] — Target:
tools.howUsed: 1. Define the objective. 2. Write 2-5 key results. 3. Assign owners. 4. Track weekly.

principles: Key results are quantitative and time-bound
OKRs should be ambitious — 70% attainment is considered success
